correctness.rationale: For any squarefree monic octic, nine tame branch points yield genus seven; the seven displayed regular differentials form a basis. Explicit Cartier identities give off-diagonal blocks A and B with ranks 2, and twisted matrix multiplication gives the stated iterate ranks. Rank-one factorization proves the dichotomy for further twisted powers, and the equation Q=H^[4]H=0 projectivizes to the embedded rational quintic. Its cone singularity and codimension follow from explicit affine charts; choice of remaining coefficients ensures squarefree fibers exist in every stratum. The separate exact finite-field verifier exhausts F2 and F4 monic octics and checks a sample over F8, with no finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: The problem is to determine the stable Frobenius/Cartier ranks and their geometric degeneration loci for a classical genus-seven cyclic trigonal family. It yields a complete reduced coefficient-space stratification, differentiates two p-rank-zero nilpotence types, and identifies an irreducible codimension-two cone over a smooth rational quintic with a genuine vertex singularity. This goes beyond a routine first-rank calculation or small arbitrary example; general theory supplies tools but not the explicit higher-iterate nonlinear geometric classification.
